result:
I rewrote `test/test_profile_model.py` to be fully self-contained. An autouse `seeded_models` fixture (mirroring `test_a_models_bootstrap.py`) points the data layer at an isolated SQLite file in `tmp_path`, reloads `db_flags`/`models` so they observe the new env, and calls the real `models.init_db()` to create the schema and seed the `demo` user (id=1) — no other test module needed. No implementation file was touched, and `get_user_profile` remains unimplemented.

Verification: `pytest test/test_profile_model.py -v` (run alone) now reaches the behavioral assertions, with all three tests failing on the `getattr` guard as `AssertionError` (not `OperationalError: no such table`, not `ImportError`). The locked phrase `profile key-set equals contract` appears in both the test source and the failure output — a valid RED.
